description: Everything you can pass to studio_create_design (or put in a Studio link): bed shapes with their dimension keys and ready example sizes, plot shapes and size presets, house/entrance/style/wants values, limits, and the product line (Brick Premium only: 60 mm larch snap-in panels and connector pins). Call it first when unsure what values are allowed. Static, free, no prices (use studio_pricing_quote or studio_create_design for prices).
